channel.title: Gaia's Secret Agents — Nature Missions & Printable Adventures
channel.description: Screen-free nature missions, printable activities and family adventures for children aged 6–11.

item.title: 10 Environmental Activities for Kids Ages 6–11 — Screen-Free & Low Prep
item.description: Ten practical environmental activities for children aged 6–11, including biodiversity surveys, sound maps, pollinator watches, bird observations and shore investigations. Most need only paper, a pencil and 10–30 minutes.

item.title: Secret Meeting Cards for Kids — 16 Printable Family Adventure Cards
item.description: Turn 10–20 minutes into a screen-free family Secret Meeting. Includes 16 printable TALK, IMAGINE and DO cards, a meeting guide, Earth action sheet and printable storage box. Ages 6–11.

item.title: Free 9-Page Secret Agent Nature Mission for Kids Ages 6–11
item.description: Download a free screen-free Secret Agent mission for children aged 6–11. Create an Agent code name, complete a 15-minute Nature Signal Hunt and make an Earth Protector promise. Parent or guardian email required for instant access.

item.title: 12 Screen-Free Ocean Activities for Kids Ages 6–11
item.description: Try rock-pool investigations, sound maps, simple current experiments and ocean-protection missions at the beach or at home. Low prep, useful and screen-free.
